title: Live producers for the harness momentum levers (ADX-tightened trail; momentum-stale time stop) in the trend_donchian + pullback monitors -- the three confirmed real-money exit cells of 2026-10-18 have no way to fire
owner: manager (Tier-2 build lane; operator OK to ship)
note: [2026-10-18 lane ACTIVE-MGMT-DRIVE-1018] WHY: three P1 confirmations passed their registered rules the same morning on real-money legs and none can be declared, because the lever exists only in the harness. MEASURED (run artifacts; records land at the 07:20Z collector): RQ-20261016-005 trend_donchian_eth_4h M1 trail_adx_below 20 / trail_adx_tight_mult 2.5: 111.37 vs 88.27 R over 270 vs 262 trades, 5 of 6 folds, maxDD 16.12 vs 18.06 (2020-07..2026-10); RQ-20261016-015 trend_donchian_xrp_4h M2 trail_adx_below 25 / tight 2.5: 17.07 vs 14.30 R over 68 trades, 4 of 4 folds; RQ-20261016-016 slv_pullback_1d momentum_stale_bars 8 / momentum_stale_adx_below 20: 20.73 vs 12.82 R over 89 vs 69 trades, 3 of 4 folds (alpaca_live). PRODUCER CHECK (grep src/, 2026-10-18): trend_donchian.monitor() and the pullback monitors read only trail_decay_* / stale_exit_* / giveback_*; the ADX trail (momentum_trail_armed / _fired, effective_trail_mult) and the momentum-stale stop (momentum_stale_armed / _fires) live in src/research/trail_levers.py and are imported by scripts/backtest_trend.py + backtest_pullback.py only. BUILD (Tier-2, runtime exit path): the live monitors import the SAME functions from src/research/trail_levers.py (one definition, the harness parity rule), read trail_adx_below / trail_adx_falling_bars / trail_adx_tight_mult and momentum_stale_bars / momentum_stale_adx_below from the leg config, ABSENT = off (byte-identical behaviour when undeclared, like trail_decay), closed bars only, the shared wilder_adx; the momentum-stale stop is a close verb so the prop paths must either carry it or the leg must refuse it (the stale_exit precedent, PI-20261006-KX6ZKFNA-0001); the ADX trail is a tighter trail_mult, which every path already carries. Add both keys to m20_fleet_exit_sweep.LEVER_DECLARED_KEYS so matrix-config-agreement sees them; regime_debt_matrix.build_harness_cmd maps the keys to the flags so A arms stay config-exact. Tests: parity of effective trail per bar between the monitor and the harness on one recorded path (position_path_history rows exist). Ship as a held Tier-2 PR (deploy + restart, nothing changes until a leg declares a key); then Q6 parity on 1-2 live trades per leg (observe-only: declare on bybit_1 first), then the Tier-3 declares (P1-Q6-eth4h-stop-declare, P1-Q6-xrp4h-declare, P1-Q6-slv1d-declare). Money at stake: bybit_2 eth_4h + xrp_4h and alpaca_live slv_1d (3 of the 8 real-money routings). Cost ~1 Opus lane / $25.

observation.what: (1) DEPLOYED: VM /api/diag/status git_sha_on_disk is at or past d9b4019f6 (merge of #18921, 2026-10-18 10:28Z); the hooks import src.runtime.momentum_levers lazily inside monitor(), so a running trader picks the module up on the next monitor pass after ict-git-sync pulls it, no restart needed. (2) OBSERVED: after the first Tier-3 declare of trail_adx_below/momentum_stale_bars on a rostered leg (P1-Q6 eth_4h / xrp_4h ADX trail, slv_1d momentum-stale), one open package shows a soak row with lever=momentum_trail or closes with reason momentum_stale. Until a leg declares the keys the producers are dormant by design and this row stays landed_unproven.
observation.how_to_check: scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh status | grep -o "git_sha_on_disk[^,]*" ; git merge-base --is-ancestor d9b4019f6 <that sha> ; then scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh "journalctl?unit=ict-trader-live&lines=4000" | grep -c "momentum_trail\|momentum_stale"
